00067 void ASRUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {
00069   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071   
00072   // AttackSegment
00073   if(currentSegment == AttackSegment)
00074   {
00075     if(attackTime_ <= 0.f) setSustainSegment();
00076     
00077     while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == AttackSegment)
00078     {
00079       *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00080       currentValue += increment;
00081       
00082       if(currentValue >= sustainLevel_) setSustainSegment();
00083       
00084       --numSamplesToProcess;
00085     }
00086   }
00087   
00088   // SustainSegment
00089   while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == SustainSegment)
00090   {
00091     *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00092     --numSamplesToProcess;
00093   }
00094   
00095   // ReleaseSegment
00096   while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == ReleaseSegment)
00097   {
00098     *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00099     currentValue -= increment;
00100     
00101     if(currentValue <= 0.f) setEnvDone();
00102     
00103     --numSamplesToProcess;
00104   }
00105   
00106   // StealSegment
00107   if(currentSegment == StealSegment)
00108   {
00109     increment = currentValue / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00110   
00111     while(numSamplesToProcess && currentSegment == StealSegment)
00112     {
00113       *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00114       currentValue -= increment;
00115       --numSamplesToProcess;
00116     }
00117     
00118     setEnvDone();
00119   }
00120   
00121   // clean up
00122   if(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00123   {
00124     while(numSamplesToProcess) 
00125     {
00126       *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00127       shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00128       --numSamplesToProcess;
00129     }
00130   }
00131   
00132 }
